items.title: Chink Martin Interview, 1966-10-19
items.q: He says, hey Brian. He says, wasn't you here four or five years ago? I said, yeah, yes sir.

ctx.x: Yeah. I said, man, I wish I was lucky that he would put that up. Because I had that more insecure than the other two, you see. So I went up there in the car. Boy, it was my rock. He put out that God-dannable. You see what I was doing? And he went, he went, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom. He says, hold on. He says, hey Brian. He says, wasn't you here four or five years ago? I said, yeah, yes sir. He says, well, man, he says, why didn't you do that before? I says, well, I don't know. You're a little excited and…
Very good. Very good. Very good. Very good.
